newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA KERSAF NET INTEREST INCOME UP.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA KERSAF NET INTEREST INCOME UP.

text.p: South Africa's Kersaf Investments Ltd said on Monday that its net interest income had risen by 23.6 million rand to 41.9 million rand for the year ended June 30, 1997.
The firm added in a statement that revenues had jumped four percent to 2.8 billion rand including disposed businesses. Excluding the sales the jump was nine percent.
The firm said its normal associate earnings had risen from 46.8 million rand to 85.8 million rand, mainly due to a good performance from Sun International Hotels Ltd.
No other financial details were immediately available.
Chairman Buddy Hawton said the firm had a large war chest to expand its activites and the firm expected to boost its earnings in the current year.

"The group has significant cash resourecs at its disposal which is pleasing as it is the intention of the group to actively pursue new investment opportunities within the hotel, gaming and leisure industries both in Africa and internationally," he said.
